label: D-40bdcc

defects.summary: One cancelled agy probe ends the whole DecidedAsync loop, so the round also loses the park or lift it had already decided for other keys (codex, claude, kimi), not only the agy key.

An undecided agy refusal asks /quota only when the word scan already calls it hopeless (Qualifies), so an undecided RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED without spent words (possible in the older code/message shape) never reaches the gauge, but D5 says the gauge decides the undecided agy case.

S33 runs the page with runPageHtml but throws the result away and asserts on the parsed static tree, but the plan and PROJECT.md's webview rule ask for the line and badge to be read off the RUNNING page.
The new implementation status line was added above the old 'plan only, nothing implemented yet' status, and the old line was not changed, so the header now says two different things.

A second QuotaKeyOf(model, apiKey) overload, the +key keys and an env-name heuristic (RunsOnApiKey) are added beyond D3; this is recorded as deviation 12, but it widens the interface and keeps two different ways (env vs vault) to decide the same fact.
A hand-written brace and quote scanner (about 100 lines plus a new CA1502 section) reads the multi-line AGY_ERROR object; a JSON reader that stops after one value would do the same with less code.
TellOnce gives a notice on every refused write, not once, so its name says something the code does not do.
The CLAUDE_SPEND envelope is copied into a new constant instead of reusing AClaudeReasonInItsEnvelopeTests.SpendLimit, and the Edited/Bucket/Sink test helpers are copied between two test classes.
Left() writes the rounded-up time-left rule again on the C# side, a second copy of the rule in resetWords.ts.

summary: The build, both suites and format are green, and all 43 scenarios are present and pass; the code delivers D1–D12 faithfully: the three-valued verdict, the agy readers, the table, a locked fail-open file, the per-key aggregation after the round, the roster exclusion, the wire member and the card. Every deviation (S25's date, S34's undecided row, API-key keys, reds not seen) is recorded honestly in §12; what remains is minor: cancellation scope, a test that does not read the running page, a stale status line, and some extra or duplicated code.
